description: List journal entries (verifikationer) with paging, optionally between from and to or narrowed by a raw query filter. For the postings on one account use bokio_account_ledger.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

name: bokio_list_journal_entries
